The Remarried Empress Is Now Streaming: Cast, Plot & More | Explore Disney+ Movies & Shows 
 Royally Scandalous K-Drama The Remarried Empress Is Now Streaming
 by Explore Disney+ Contributor
 Revised: November 4, 2026 
 Discover the fantasy romance K-drama now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu, including its webtoon roots, cast, and episode release details 
 The new, swoon-worthy romance show set in opulent palace halls is now on Hulu and Disney+. Betrayed by her husband, Empress Navier refuses to be sidelined, turning heartbreak into a chance to reclaim her destiny and find a new love that could alter her kingdom’s fate.
 Whether you’ve been eagerly awaiting the adaptation of the rofan (romance fantasy) webtoon or are looking for a polished K-drama full of romance, scandal, imperial court intrigue, and fantasy, The Remarried Empress is set to become your next obsession. Watch the trailer, get the episode release schedule, and find out who’s in the cast of the live-action show.
 Watch The Remarried Empress Official Trailer 
 Add The Remarried Empress to Watchlist 
 What is The Remarried Empress about? 
 The Remarried Empress, Hulu, Disney+ Empress Navier is blindsided by her husband Emperor Sovieshu of the Eastern Empire, when he declares that he’s fallen in love with another woman and wants a divorce. Now, Navier has a choice to make. While her life as she knows it teeters, Navier resolves to turn deceit and pain into an opportunity and offers her husband a bold deal. She'll agree to the divorce, as long as she is granted permission to remarry. But the most shocking detail is who she hopes to make her new husband. Navier has Prince Heinrey of the rival Western Kingdom in her sights, believing he could be the key to her new life.
 In true rofan fashion, the royals’ private relationships shape their kingdoms’ futures, and romantic gestures become entangled with political motivations. Though set in a lavish fantasy world, Navier’s journey, from an underestimated and scorned wife to a woman intent on coming out on top with her dignity intact, is a relatable tale about resilience and what it means to create your own destiny.
 Is The Remarried Empress a live-action show? 
 Yes. The new show is a live-action K-drama based on the hit NAVER WEBTOON of the same name.
 How does the show adapt the webtoon? 
 The Remarried Empress, Hulu, Disney+ The show brings the webtoon’s palatial decadence to the screen with breathtaking settings and elaborate costumes. Set in a fantasy realm, it takes you on a journey marked by ambition, melodrama, and imperial intrigue.
 Where can I watch The Remarried Empress ? 
 The first episodes are ready to stream now on Hulu and Disney+.
 When does The Remarried Empress come out? 
 The show kicked off with a 4-episode premiere on November 4. 
 Take a peek behind the scenes with The Remarried Empress: A Special Look on Disney+ and Hulu .
 How many episodes will The Remarried Empress have? 
 There will be 10 episodes in total.
 What is the episode release schedule? 
 After the 4-episode premiere, two new episodes arrive weekly until the finale on November 25.
 Will an English-dubbed version of The Remarried Empress be available? 
 Yes, you can watch the show in the original Korean with English subtitles or a dubbed version with English audio .
 Who are the characters and cast of The Remarried Empress ? 
 The Remarried Empress, Hulu, Disney+ Find out who plays the webtoon’s key characters in the live-action adaptation of The Remarried Empress .
 Navier played by Shin Mina 
 Navier, the beloved Empress of the Eastern Empire, is at the center of the story as she seeks to decide her own future after her husband’s infidelity and request for divorce.
 Sovieshu played by Ju Jihoon 
 Emperor of the Eastern Empire, Sovieshu sets the story in motion when he announces that he’s fallen in love with another woman and wants to divorce his wife.
 K-drama fans may recognize Ju Ji-hoon from his roles as Woo Chae-woon in the sci-fi thriller Blood Free (Hulu) and Jung Won-young in the webtoon adaptation Light Shop (Hulu).
 Heinrey played by Lee Jongsuk 
 Heinrey is the Prince of the Western Kingdom who Navier wants to marry after her divorce from the Emperor.
 You can see more of Lee Jong-suk in the legal thriller Big Mouth .
 Rashta played by Lee Seyoung 
 Rashta is the charming young runaway who Sovieshu falls for.
 Who's behind The Remarried Empress ? 
 Cho Suwon directs the webtoon adaptation written by Yeoh Geena. Studio N produces the show.
